timeline_events.body: AMF decision 17 Apr 2020 fined Elliott Advisors UK Ltd EUR15M and Elliott Capital Advisors LP EUR5M for inaccurate/late tender-offer reporting (reported cash-settled CFDs when instruments were equity swaps; belated declaration of intent) re: XPO's 2015 bid for Norbert Dentressangle; EAUK also fined for OBSTRUCTING the AMF investigation. Upheld by Paris Court of Appeal 24 Mar 2022 (EUR14M + EUR4.5M); appeal pending at Cour de Cassation. Aggravated by a prior EUR8M AMF insider-trading fine (2014). Repeat disclosure/conduct-controls weakness.
